description: List cryptocurrency pairs matching a cryptocurrency (e.g. 'ETH') and/or the currency it is quoted in (e.g. 'USD' or 'BTC'), or matching a free-text query on symbol or name. Every filter accepts one value or several comma-separated values.

cryptocurrency.description: Cryptocurrency code, e.g. 'ETH', 'ADA' or 'XRP'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
cryptocurrency.title: Cryptocurrency

currency.description: Trading currency as an ISO code, e.g. 'USD' or 'EUR'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
currency.title: Currency

include_summary.description: Add the business/fund description (truncated to 300 characters). Off by default to keep responses small.
include_summary.title: Include Summary

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (see the `_notes` hint in the response).
offset.title: Offset

query.description: Optional free-text search on symbol and name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'apple' or 'AAPL'); an ISIN also matches where available. Best matches come first.
query.title: Query

show_columns.description: Columns to return, comma-separated. Default: symbol, name, cryptocurrency, currency, exchange. Available: symbol, name, cryptocurrency, currency, summary, exchange, website.
show_columns.title: Show Columns

name: cryptos
